{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Dog''' (壬戌, ''mizunoe inu''; onyomi ''jinjutsu'') is the 59th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 59th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Rooster|ja|辛酉}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Pig|ja|癸亥}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Dog (壬戌)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénxū
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 seot1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-inu
*** On'yomi: jinjutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): im sul (임술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Tuất

==Months of Yang Water Dog==
In a Common Era year, if the final digit is 3 or 8 (that is, when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), then {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of Jinshitsu. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Japanese Lunisolar Calendar}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Hanro}} until the day before {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Rittō}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Water Dog==
=== Day Selection ===
A day of Jinshitsu is one of the intercalary days from {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}}.
